why: Tony: "what's RT6150B-33GQW for? it is also out of stock"; after the explanation he chose "RT6150BGQW + divider" (the adjustable version of the same chip, already used for U8)
u7_regulator_swap_2026_09_24.function: U7 is a Richtek RT6150B buck-boost converter making IO_3V3 from SYSTEM_SUPPLY (battery 3.0-4.2 V, or 4.4 V from the charger on USB); EN tied to SYSTEM_SUPPLY (always on), PS tied to GND (power-save mode). IO_3V3 feeds PANEL_LOGIC through U10, the touch controller (U3 pin 8) and R28/R29, the microphone supply through U2, and the 100k pull-ups R12-R19/R41; the MCU and the flash run from MCU_LDO1
u7_regulator_swap_2026_09_24.part: RT6150BGQW, LCSC C147972 (about 1,350 in stock at LCSC on 2026-09-24), WDFN-10 2.5 x 2.5, same pinout as RT6150B-33GQW; only pin 10 (FB) differs: the fixed version needs FB tied to VOUT, the adjustable one a divider (VFB 0.495-0.505 V, FB input current max 50 nA, datasheet DS6150A/B-06)

divider.values: R42 1M (IO_3V3 -> FB, RC0402FR-071ML, placed as UniOhm 0402WGF1004TCE C26083) and R43 180k (FB -> GND, RC0402FR-07180KL, placed as UniOhm 0402WGF1803TCE C25760, about 165,000 in stock)
divider.output: 0.5 V x (1 + 1000/180) = 3.28 V nominal; about 3.2-3.35 V with VFB and 1% resistor tolerances; FB leakage (max 50 nA x 1M) adds at most 0.05 V
divider.datasheet_limits: R2 = 180k inside the recommended 80k-500k; the feed-forward formula Cff = 20 pF x (487k/R1) - 20 pF gives no capacitor for R1 >= 487k, so none is fitted (U8 has none either)
divider.why_not_datasheet_values: 487k/86.6k (3.31 V) is the datasheet example, but no 487k 0402 was found in stock at LCSC; 1M/180k uses two well-stocked parts and draws 2.8 uA from the always-on rail
